# Rapid — projectile identity, VFX & SFX

Child of AH-0MV2K5SR0005RTTE (Variety in weapon graphics). Visuals-only: gives the `rapid` player weapon a distinct in-flight projectile look, per-shot VFX and fire/impact SFX through the shared bullet-shape seam.

## Goal (user story)

As a player, I want the Rapid's shots to render as a small, fast disc with a staccato muzzle flash and short trail, so I can read at a glance which weapon I am holding and feel it when it fires and connects.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Every player weapon is visually unique in flight.** Each of the 11 catalogue weapons (`cannon, spread, dual, rapid, wave_laser, ricochet, cluster, options, nova, mortar, arc`) has a distinct code-drawn projectile shape and/or per-shot VFX that differs from every other weapon; a doc/roster test asserts catalogue-wide uniqueness. The Rapid shot is a small, fast disc with a staccato muzzle flash and short trail.
- **Per-weapon game feel.** Each weapon/attack child adds VFX **and** SFX for both fire and impact (muzzle flash / launch cue, trail where appropriate, impact flash + hit sound), consistent with the code-drawn neon aesthetic and the existing baked-cue audio pipeline (ToneForge `playCue`). The Rapid's fire cue is existing `playWeaponFireSound` cue reused (already present) and its impact cue is newly baked ToneForge impact cue.
- Fire VFX (muzzle flash / launch cue) and any trail for `rapid` are wired through the shared combat-core spawn path as cheap Graphics primitives in the `src/vfx/` style.
- A distinct impact flash + hit sound plays when a `rapid` shot connects, routed through the shared impact path so game and gyms behave identically.
- **Gym↔game parity.** Every gameplay-visual change is applied through the shared core (`src/scenes/core/`, shared entities/utils) and consumed identically by the relevant gym scene(s) and `PlayScene`; the repo duplicate-body guard and gym-parity assertions must pass unchanged. No behaviour/balance re-tuning (fire rates, beat grid, speeds, damage, ranges stay as-is).
- **Full test suite passes** with the new changes, including updated graphics command-buffer tests and new per-weapon visual/audio tests.

## Key Files

- `src/entities/PlayerBullet.ts` — per-shape rendering driven by the weapon definition
- `src/utils/weapons.ts` — `rapid` visual metadata (shape/visual fields)
- `src/utils/weaponLevels.ts` — carry visual fields through level resolution unchanged
- `src/audio/effects.ts` + `src/audio/cueManifest.ts` — fire/impact cues
- `src/vfx/` — `rapid` muzzle/trail/impact module(s)
- `src/scenes/core/CombatCoreScene.ts` / `CombatScene.ts` — shared spawn/impact hooks
- `src/scenes/PlayScene.ts` + `src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts` — parity adoption

## Dependencies

- Parent: AH-0MV2K5SR0005RTTE
- Shared bullet-shape rendering seam (prerequisite child)

## Scope guard

Visuals/feel only. Any behaviour/balance change discovered while adding feel must be filed as a separate work item (`related-to:AH-0MV2K5SR0005RTTE`), not absorbed here.
